_readme: Design data for Fire_StairPressurisation (BS EN 12101-6 pressure-differential systems). Project override: <project>/_BIM_COORD/smoke_control_design.json. Only classes whose criteria are stated here are offered; add others from the edition of BS EN 12101-6 in force and the fire strategy. Everything marked verify=true must be checked before the fan duty is specified.

systemClasses.label: Class A — means of escape, defend in place
Class B — means of escape and firefighting
Custom — criteria from the fire strategy

doorLeakageAreasM2._note: Leakage area of one closed door, m². Commonly published BS EN 12101-6 values; verify.

_openDoorsNote: How many doors are open in the velocity case depends on the class and the building; set openDoors from the fire strategy.
_leakageAllowanceNote: Multiplier on the calculated supply for leakage the calculation cannot see. Set it to the value the fire strategy or the standard's edition requires.
_openCaseNote: Differential across doors that stay closed while the velocity case runs. 0 = keep the design pressure (conservative).
